finite_mass_definition: For m>0, dX=Vdt and m dV=-gamma Vdt+sqrt(2gamma T(X))dW on a periodic ring, started in its stationary joint density. Calorimetric bath entropy S_env=-integral m V/T(X) circ dV. First take t→infinity in E[S_env]/t or Var(S_env)/t; then m→0 at fixed bath controls.
boundary_identity: S_env=-Delta[m V²/(2T)]-integral m V³ Tprime/(2T²)dt. Defining A=integral (3T-mV²)V Tprime/(2T²)dt gives S_env=A-Delta[mV²/(2T)]-(3/2)Delta logT. The endpoint variables have finite stationary moments at every positive m and do not change long-time mean/variance rates.
finite_mass_reference: G=m L_forward is the full Kramers generator in Fourier position and Gaussian-weighted normalized Hermite velocity. H multiplies by the cubic observable. G p=0, integral p=1; mu=integral H p. Solve G p1=-m(H-mu)p with integral p1=0; variance rate=2 integral H p1. This is an eigenvalue-derivative identity for L_forward+lambda H, independent of the reduced model.
reduced_cross_term: The limiting fast entropy Wiener process is independent of the entire position Wiener process. Conditional on the complete position path, its integral has mean0 and variance2 integral a dt. Hence its covariance with the conditional-mean entropy functional vanishes exactly; the total variance is positional occupation variance plus2mean, at finite times for the anomalous functional and in long-time rates for calorimetric entropy.
reduced_generator: L=(T/gamma)partial_x², rho proportional1/T, a=Tprime²/(2gamma T). The counting generator is L+(lambda+lambda²)a, which is invariant underlambda→-1-lambda and has principal eigenvalue0 atlambda0,-1.
small_amplitude: AtT=T0(1+c cos(kx)), mean=T0 k²(1-sqrt(1-c²))/(2gamma); shortcut variance~T0 k² c⁴/(64gamma). Correct variance~T0 k² c²/(2gamma), so variance/(2mean)→1.
limitations: Three prototype controls establish feasibility, not full domain validation or empirical model difficulty. Treat as entropy-anomaly family revision; all earlier sources and outcomes remain unchanged.
